title: SciIntBench: Measuring LLM Compliance with Research Integrity Norms Under Adversarial Framing
reasoning: The paper introduces SciIntBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate how well Large Language Models adhere to professional ethics in research (Research Integrity Norms). It specifically tests the models' ability to refuse unethical requests such as data fabrication, falsification, and plagiarism, which are fundamental topics in professional and research ethics.
